summary: The article provides a largely accurate overview of Amazon's and chipmakers' Q2 2026 earnings, with most key financial figures and growth rates verified by multiple sources. However, there are some discrepancies in NVIDIA's reported EPS and TSMC's revenue figures.

claims.claim: Amazon reported net sales of $200.6 billion in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm Amazon's Q2 2026 net sales of $200.6 billion.

claims.claim: Amazon Web Services (AWS) revenue grew by 37% year-over-year in Q2 2026, reaching $42.2 billion.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm AWS revenue growth of 37% to $42.2 billion in Q2 2026.

claims.claim: Amazon's diluted earnings per share (EPS) stood at an impressive $5.75 in Q2 2026.
claims.note: Amazon's official press release and other sources confirm diluted EPS of $5.75 for Q2 2026.

claims.claim: TSMC reported revenue of $40.2 billion in Q2 2026, an impressive 36% increase year-over-year, and its net profit surged by 77.4%.
claims.note: TSMC's official announcement confirms Q2 2026 revenue of $40.20 billion (USD) and a 77.4% increase in net income year-over-year.

claims.claim: NVIDIA reported robust Q2 FY2026 earnings, with earnings per share (EPS) of $1.87 surpassing consensus estimates of $1.7922 by 4.34%.
claims.note: NVIDIA's Q2 FY2026 GAAP diluted EPS was $1.08 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.05. The article's stated EPS of $1.87 appears to be an estimate for Q1 FY2027, not Q2 FY2026.

claims.claim: NVIDIA's earlier Q2 FY2026 (calendar Q1 2026) results showed record total revenue of $46.7 billion, a 56% year-over-year increase, with data center revenue alone reaching $41.1 billion.
claims.note: NVIDIA's Q2 FY2026 (ended July 27, 2025) revenue was $46.7 billion, up 56% year-over-year, with data center revenue of $41.1 billion.

claims.claim: Looking ahead to Q3 2026, Amazon anticipates net sales between $197.0 billion and $202.0 billion, representing 9% to 12% growth year-over-year, and operating income between $22.5 billion and $26.5 billion.
claims.note: Amazon's official Q2 2026 results press release provides this guidance for Q3 2026.

article_title: Amazon's Strong Earnings Drive Wall Street Surge Amidst AI Optimism
